#### Articulated Closed-State and Local-Trajectory Uncertainty

The articulated qualification cannot treat one nominal anatomy, joint-limit
envelope, grip, or equipment definition as if it were universal. A registered
deterministic Latin-hypercube screen therefore perturbs nine engineering
inputs: height scale (0.90--1.10), body-mass scale (0.85--1.15), joint-limit
scale (0.85--1.15), total grip stiffness (1000--3000 N/m), grip damping
(10--35 N s/m), friction coefficient (0.15--0.65), club mass
(0.28--0.42 kg), club moment-of-inertia scale (0.80--1.25), and initial club
velocity (0.01--0.20 m/s). These bounds are declared engineering ranges, not
measured distributions of golfers or equipment.

Each of the 40 samples rebuilds the subject-scaled model, changes height and
mass independently, rescales the joint-limit envelope, and re-solves bilateral
hand-to-grip closure before forward integration. A sample that fails inverse
kinematics, bilateral closure, the joint-limit screen, the coarse collision
screen, or the six-row constraint-rank check is retained with an explicit
status and excluded from response correlation. A feasible sample is advanced
through the distributed-grip production path with the registered timestep
pair. Peak station force, peak force couple, maximum sliding speed, transition
count, and normalized work--energy residual are recorded. Partial rank
correlations (PRCCs) are calculated only over rows whose five responses are
finite.

All 40 registered rows produced finite response vectors and satisfied the 5%
normalized work--energy closure gate; the maximum residual was 0.00696. Every
row nevertheless recorded partial opening as its first contact-domain status.
That adverse result rejects any reading of this excitation as robustly
full-contact across the declared envelope. It does not invalidate the retained
trajectory calculations, but it conditions their PRCC screen on trajectories
that open at least one station.

Within that conditional screen, the largest absolute PRCC for peak station
force was initial velocity (+0.936); for peak force couple, height scale
(-0.500); for maximum sliding speed, friction coefficient (-0.940); for total
transition count, height scale (-0.760); and for normalized work--energy
residual, body-mass scale (+0.931). The final association concerns a numerical
diagnostic that remained inside its gate, not a physical performance outcome.
The finite design supplies neither sampling intervals nor evidence that these
rankings persist under interactions or another excitation.

![Articulated Closed-State and Local-Trajectory Uncertainty Screen](figures/fig_articulated_uncertainty_screen.pdf){#fig-articulated-uncertainty-screen width=100%}

Figure @fig-articulated-uncertainty-screen preserves two different questions.
The left panel is an exploratory monotone-sensitivity screen conditional on
this finite deterministic design. The right panel retains the status of every
sample, including geometry-domain failures and contact transitions. A large
PRCC magnitude is not a causal parameter effect, and a trajectory status is
not a player classification. No population confidence interval is estimated.

The governed record and arrays are available as
[`articulated_uncertainty_study.json`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/docs/research/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/data/articulated_uncertainty_study.json)
and
[`articulated_uncertainty_study.npz`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/docs/research/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/data/articulated_uncertainty_study.npz),
with the executable analysis in
[`articulated_uncertainty_study.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/scripts/research/proximal_distal_energy/articulated_uncertainty_study.py).

This screen answers whether local closure and distributed-contact calculations
remain numerically inspectable across the declared ranges. It does **not**
propagate anthropometric or joint-limit variation through the complete
126/384 shaft and 0/384 ground headline estimands. That distinction is an
open acceptance boundary for the articulated uncertainty milestone, rather
than evidence that the headline conclusions are anatomically robust.
